answer: A grove grown from burnt relics can't be faked. A ballot sprouts only from a relic: a credential earned over thirty tides, burned on the spot, its ash planted in the registry — one relic, one ballot, ever. Relic farms die by the ash check: one ash feeding two ballots gets both slashed and burned, stakes and all. Each tide, fifty yarrow stalks set the minimum relic age, so fresh credentials can't sprout. Forging 10,000 ballots needs 10,000 relics, 1,800,000 hours and $500,000 burned, plus $25 staked. Stumps remember every cut tree; a farm's ballots leave ash and an empty wallet.
